description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes for the TinySRP password and configuration management, part of the Stanford SRP Authentication Project. It includes cryptographic parameter handling, password file access, and utility functions related to SRP authentication.

methods.name: t_getprecount
methods.description: Returns the number of precompiled SRP parameter sets.

methods.name: t_getpreparam
methods.description: Retrieves a specific precompiled SRP parameter set by index.

methods.name: t_openconf
methods.description: Opens a configuration file stream.

methods.name: t_openconfbyname
methods.description: Opens a configuration file by filename.

methods.name: t_closeconf
methods.description: Closes an open configuration file.

methods.name: t_rewindconf
methods.description: Resets the configuration file stream to the beginning.

methods.name: t_getconfent
methods.description: Fetches the next configuration entry.

methods.name: t_getconfbyindex
methods.description: Fetches a configuration entry by index.

methods.name: t_getconflast
methods.description: Fetches the last configuration entry.

methods.name: t_makeconfent
methods.description: Generates a random configuration entry.

methods.name: t_makeconfent_c
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with specific parameters.

methods.name: t_newconfent
methods.description: Returns an empty configuration entry.

methods.name: t_cmpconfent
methods.description: Compares two configuration entries.

methods.name: t_checkconfent
methods.description: Verifies if a configuration entry is valid.

methods.name: t_putconfent
methods.description: Writes a configuration entry to a stream.

methods.name: gettcent
methods.description: Returns the current configuration entry.

methods.name: gettcid
methods.description: Returns a configuration entry by ID.

methods.name: settcent
methods.description: Sets the current configuration context.

methods.name: endtcent
methods.description: Ends the configuration context.

methods.name: t_openpw
methods.description: Opens a password file stream.

methods.name: t_openpwbyname
methods.description: Opens a password file by filename.

methods.name: t_closepw
methods.description: Closes an open password file.

methods.name: t_rewindpw
methods.description: Resets the password file stream.

methods.name: t_getpwent
methods.description: Retrieves the next password entry.

methods.name: t_getpwbyname
methods.description: Looks up a password entry by username.

methods.name: t_makepwent
methods.description: Constructs a password entry.

methods.name: t_putpwent
methods.description: Writes a password entry to a stream.

methods.name: gettpent
methods.description: Returns the current password entry.

methods.name: gettpnam
methods.description: Returns a password entry by username.

methods.name: settpent
methods.description: Sets the password file context.

methods.name: endtpent
methods.description: Ends the password file context.

methods.name: t_verifypw
methods.description: Verifies a username and password against the system password file.

methods.name: t_changepw
methods.description: Changes a user's password in the password file.

methods.name: t_deletepw
methods.description: Deletes a user from the password file.

methods.name: t_tohex
methods.description: Converts binary data to hexadecimal string.

methods.name: t_fromhex
methods.description: Converts hexadecimal string to binary data.

methods.name: t_tob64
methods.description: Encodes binary data to base64.

methods.name: t_fromb64
methods.description: Decodes base64 string to binary data.

methods.name: t_random
methods.description: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: t_stronginitrand
methods.description: Initializes the random number generator.

methods.name: t_sessionkey
methods.description: Generates a session key from hash inputs.

methods.name: t_getpass
methods.description: Reads a password from terminal without echo.

methods.name: t_checkprime
methods.description: Checks if a number is prime and safe.
